desc:
Your feed, but every post is a game you can play 🎮

Swipe up and you're straight into the next arcade game!

🛠️ NEW: Make your own games!
Pick an obby, runner, flyer, maze, blaster or catcher, choose a world and a hero, then build it with blocks, enemies, traps, power-ups and rules. Beat your game to share it, and everyone can play it in the Creations tab

🔑 Send friends your game's code so they can jump straight in
🔁 Remix games and make them your own
🔨 Reach 20,000 likes on your games to earn the Maker badge

❤️ Like, comment and save the games you love
🎬 Clip your best runs, trim them and post them to your profile
👥 Follow players and chase your friends' high scores
🏆 Climb the weekly, monthly and all-time leaderboards
💖 Revive to keep a great run going

Play on phone, tablet, PC or controller
